description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Ignis)], and [Fire Resonance +5%] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Ignis)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Physical Quick Cast 1] to all allies after using Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Ignis)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Ignis)
description.text: [Thief Instant Cast], [Support Instant Cast], grants [D Royal Menu Mode] after using a Thief/Support ability

description.name: Thief Instant Cast
description.text: Instant cast speed for Thief abilities

description.name: D Royal Menu Mode
description.text: Grants [100% Critical (15s)], [Critical Damage +50% (15s)] and [Deadly Strikes +20% (15s)] to ally after they use a Fire/Lightning/Earth ability (max 3 chases)

description.name: Critical Damage +50% (15s)
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% (15s)
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
